planner_directives: Use one coherent anime/manhwa frame rather than a collage or reference sheet.
Treat recurring character identity and visible state as the primary continuity problem.

For every cut, author narrative_overlays and materialize the chosen graphic inside provider_prompt. Most cuts should integrate one short additive RPG/game text panel, manhwa speech or thought bubble, or manhwa reaction treatment; reserve [] for purposeful clean frames where lettering would weaken the image.
